verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a REST interface, CLI (search/add/tool call), and token-scoping for using MCP connections programmatically, showing meaningful API parity for connecting/using servers. However, there's no evidence of an API/CLI path for the full build/publish/namespace-management workflows (publishing appears UI/URL-flow oriented) and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, undermining claims of complete API-UI parity. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/API reference confirming full CRUD coverage, API-driven publishing/namespace management, independent corroboration of API completeness.
